description:
AC applied a DT day-of-travel schedule change (INVOL) pushing arrival to 19:00, then customer called the Contact Center and voluntarily changed to an EARLIER flight (ADDCOL + no ACNP = -ve VOL) arriving at 15:00. Customer is mitigating by going earlier � negative VOL is NOT deducted. Full delay from promise (10:00) to actual (15:00) = 5hrs is used.
